subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 6: /f/ (fat, fit, fig, fin); segmenting and blending; differentiates r and f

show.line: Listen. f, f, fish. Like air from a flat tyre! Fish starts with f.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with f, as in fish?
Say the sound with me. f, as in fan!
Listen. f, i, n. What word is it?
Is it r or f? Listen. Fat.

hints: Top teeth on your bottom lip. Blow! f, f, f.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. f, i, t.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! f, i, t makes fit.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. f, i, t. Fit!

parent_line: Can hear the f sound and blend words like fin, fit and fig.
